note.question: How can contrary to conventional wisdom, counterfeits increase the supply chain’s profit even in the absence of network externality effects?
note.overview: This paper investigates how counterfeits influence a global supply chain and how the supply chain should effectively take anticounterfeit actions. The impacts of counterfeiting have been increasingly profound on global supply chains. It is critical to understand how counterfeiting impacts supply chains when supply chain members act in their own interests, and how supply chains can effectively combat counterfeiting when all the members can contribute to it.
